info.description: One band of the page: the small label, the heading, the paragraphs, the photographs and the run of cells. ⚠ EVERY SECTION ON THESE PAGES IS THIS SHAPE — what differs between them is how the page LAYS IT OUT, and that stays in the page. You cannot reorder, add or remove sections; you fill in the ones that are there.

kicker.description: A few words above the heading.

heading.description: ONE LINE PER CLIPPED LINE, and {{double braces}} around the part set in italic. The page animates the lines in on its own — type the words and the breaks, nothing else.

caption.description: The small line printed under a photograph, where the design has one.

shots.description: The photographs, IN THE ORDER THE PAGE PLACES THEM. The first is the largest frame; the ones after it fill the smaller places around it.

cells.description: The run of items beside or under the copy.

cellsTwo.description: A SECOND run, for the one or two bands that carry two. Leave it empty everywhere else.
